typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features the high contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and thin, horizontal serifs characteristic of the "Modern" or Didone style (popularized by Didot and Bodoni), which was the standard for formal French printing in the mid-19th century.
